title: Scaling AI Agent Identity with CIMD and Application Profiles in Auth0
partialText: Auth0 expands Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD) support with manual pre-registration and dynamic registration. Pair it with Application Profiles to manage security for AI agent clients at scale.

title: Introducing Terraform Auth0 Modules
partialText: Set up apps, APIs, roles, MFA, enterprise SSO, and custom domains on Auth0 with a single Terraform module.

title: Your Agent Can Better Drive the Auth0 CLI with Agent Mode
partialText: Explore Auth0 CLI agent mode: structured JSON, schema checks, predictable error recovery, and more built specifically for AI coding agents.

title: Securing AI Agents with Auth0 CIMD and Token Exchange
partialText: AI agents break static authorization. Learn how Auth0 Strict Mode, CIMD, and Token Exchange keep a permission ceiling and a verifiable user-to-agent delegation chain.

title: ID-JAG, Explained: The New OAuth Grant for Cross-App Access
partialText: Learn what an ID-JAG (Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant) is, the cross-app access problem it solves, and how the flow works between a requesting app, resource app, and enterprise IdP.

title: Securing the Front Door of Agentic Commerce: Four Channels, One Identity Layer
partialText: AI agents now shop for your customers in four channels. Learn how one identity layer recognizes each agent, links it to a real customer, scopes what it can do, and turns agent traffic into sales.

title: On-Behalf-Of Is a Pattern. Token Exchange Is the Standard.
partialText: Find out the difference between On-Behalf-Of and OAuth Token Exchange, and why the two are often confused.

title: Agentic Development: Time to Shift the Focus
partialText: Agents can turn ideas into pull requests in almost no time. The hard part now is deciding what to build and validating that generated code is safe to ship. Here is a risk-based approach to both.

title: One SDK, Multiple Platforms: Introducing the Auth0 SDK for Kotlin Multiplatform
partialText: Add login, logout, and secure token storage to iOS and Android apps using the Auth0 Kotlin Multiplatform SDK. Simplify cross-platform auth.

title: Introducing the Auth0 SDK for TanStack Start
partialText: Meet the new Auth0 SDK for TanStack Start and learn how to use it to add authentication to your apps.
